verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is API- and CLI-first. Client libraries in multiple languages expose the core functionality: topics, services, actions, parameters, and bag read/write from code. The `ros2` CLI introspects and operates nodes, topics and services. GUI tools such as RViz are optional add-ons, and the bare-bones ROS-Base install ships no GUI tools at all. missing for 10: no explicit documented statement of UI-to-API parity (e.g., that RViz visualization functions are scriptable), several API features (lifecycle, composition, content filtering, intra-process) are C++-only, and no independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
